attempt_1.text: Rain spatters the soot-dark stone and frayed banners that hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach as guards hold the choke point while the crowd presses in. A notice board displays new taxes, curfews, and a warning about a missing patrol. Nearby, a tavern runner shouts offers of hot stew and paid rumor. Among the watchers, one figure in threadbare clothes stands almost unnervingly still, observing the packs and faces more than the queue itself. Although the rain adds discomfort, the guards' discipline suggests they manage to keep watch despite the wet conditions, neither clearly hindered nor supported by the weather.
